name: Bruno
summary: Bruno sends limited, anonymized usage telemetry to PostHog (us.i.posthog.com), which is on by default. Users have reported PostHog requests still occurring with the toggle off (issue #9943, still open), so the opt-out may be incomplete.

optOut.instructions: Open Bruno's global Preferences, go to the About tab, and switch off the Telemetry toggle. Then confirm in Developer Tools > Network that no requests go to us.i.posthog.com, since some users report they still do.
